text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any siblings?
Oh, of course. You have no memories.
Would you [i]like[/i] to have them, then?
choice_data_list: I'd love to have a little sister like Rem.
I'd love to have a big sister like you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたは兄妹はいるの？
ああ、
そういえば
記憶喪失だったわね。
だったら
欲しいとは思うかしら？

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text:
Not quite the answer I was looking for.
All right, listen up. I'll teach you the basics of little sisters' charms.
Sit on the floor there. No, don't sit, [i]kneel.[/i]
text_block_list.orig_text:
こういう時は嘘でも欲しいというものよ。
そうね、
じゃあ
少し妹の良さというものを教えてあげる。
そこに座りなさい。
正座よ、
正座。

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text:
A fine response... or so I'd like to say, but too bad.
Rem's [i]my[/i] little sister. You can't have her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いい目をしている、
と言いたいところだけど
残念ね。
レムはラムの妹よ。
あげないわ。

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course. But you're nowhere near worthy of that.
If you swear to do all the cooking and cleaning in my place,
I might consider you as a candidate.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ当然ね。
でも
百年早いと言わせてもらおうかしら。
ラムの代わりに
炊事掃除洗濯なんかをやってくれるなら、
少しは考えてあげてもいいわよ？
